title: Preserve candidate work across sign-in, navigation and saving
decision: Hydrate recovery only after account ownership settles; preserve exact final edits on same-input navigation; protect tracking drafts and keep optional account saving independent of local export.
dependencies: Auth loading/ownership contract | Versioned draft transitions | Existing exact-approval invalidation
acceptance_criteria: Delayed same-owner refresh restores the consented draft; another owner never sees it. | Back/forward and unchanged recheck preserve final edits; replacing source requires explicit action and undo. | Unsaved tracking notes/date survive task navigation with fresh attestation where required. | A stalled optional cloud save cannot indefinitely block an already approved local export; ambiguous save retry retains its request identity.

title: Make erasure a durable, resumable operation
decision: Fence every account mutation and storage write while erasing, persist bounded deletion progress, verify the prefix is empty, and safely collect abandoned artifacts. Add an owner procedure for loop-only and whole-account scope.
dependencies: Additive erasure state/generation migration | Worker/record/OAuth/scheduler mutation inventory | Storage enumeration and retention rules
acceptance_criteria: The locally reproduced enroll-after-begin-erase race cannot admit a new run or upload. | More than10000 synthetic storage entries erase through bounded retries that each make progress. | Cancelled upload-before-commit artifacts expire safely without removing active referenced or other-owner files. | Completion is reported only after verified scope readback; actual/uncertain monthly commitments remain retained. | A synthetic whole-account checklist covers separate checks, CV stores, Auth, files and external copies without claiming control over already downloaded files.

title: Carry the first check into one reusable application workspace
decision: Offer an owner-bound preview to continue a completed check in Job Loop, importing the chosen CV version and vacancy once. Let candidates explicitly choose one or two vacancies for manual preparation.
dependencies: JV-01 | Idempotent additive check/opportunity/tracker relationships | Run selection snapshot validation
acceptance_criteria: Chosen CV version and vacancy survive sign-in without retyping for all three audience paths. | Import requires private-storage consent; imported facts remain unconfirmed and unshareable until reviewed. | Retried import creates one linked application without destructive historical merging. | The third saved vacancy can be chosen first; two-packet and ownership limits remain server-enforced. | Test combining role and vacancy intake to remove one screen; retain user confirmation and the no-CV starter.

title: Tailor emphasis per vacancy without changing shared career facts
decision: Add a versioned selection/order of complete confirmed claims per opportunity, with requirement/source context next to the editing task. Generate interview prompts from constrained templates or verified template IDs.
dependencies: Composition hash and contextual-omission rules | Exact approval/render contract | Stable evidence references
acceptance_criteria: Shortening or reordering document B leaves source facts and document A unchanged. | A changed composition revokes B approval and is re-rendered before download. | Academic, team, projection and individual-contribution context cannot be silently omitted. | Invented titles, employers and achievements cannot enter interview questions through free-form model presuppositions. | A candidate can connect an edit to its vacancy requirement and source passage without repeated page hunting.

title: Finish one coherent, readable review-and-download journey
decision: Apply shared public/private design tokens and readable supporting text. Sequence final wording, required preview, factual approval and download; place optional save/reuse after the primary outcome.
dependencies: JV-01 | Existing exact-byte/page-count gates | Keyboard and mobile checks
acceptance_criteria: Private consent and help text are comfortably readable at supported mobile widths and zoom. | A first-time participant can identify the next primary action at every final-review state. | Changing text/format still invalidates the appropriate preview and approval. | Optional choices do not obscure approved download; no critical consent is preselected to reduce effort.

title: Prove hosted signup, recovery and received document quality
decision: Create a small repeatable deployment smoke and a rights-cleared fictional document corpus. Verify ordinary-address authentication and recovery using controlled fixture accounts; bound and cancel untrusted file extraction.
dependencies: Owner-controlled test inbox and existing SMTP/configuration evidence | Production redirect inventory | Fictional PDF/DOCX corpus | Supported device/browser matrix
acceptance_criteria: Record provider acceptance versus actual confirmation/reset receipt separately, including expired links and throttles. | Built deployment loads the real PDF worker, completes guest review, saves a file and verifies its opened content/layout. | Controlled sign-in/save/reopen preserves the selected owner and source version. | Independently reviewed multi-column, Unicode, long and scanned-document cases have correct reading order or an explicit usable fallback. | Extraction has cumulative limits, deadline and cancellation; no runaway work persists after cancellation.

title: Harden sensitive administrator actions and public intake limits
decision: Enforce recent strong administrator authentication for sensitive controls and verify intake identity only from trusted ingress. Keep fresh membership checks and server-only authority.
dependencies: Supported Supabase MFA/step-up setup | Trusted ingress header contract | Existing admin audit and account-change tests
acceptance_criteria: An otherwise valid low-assurance admin session cannot perform configured sensitive actions; recovery/enrollment is understandable. | Ordinary candidates cannot become administrators by signup, route access or client flags. | Spoofed forwarded-header fixtures cannot evade the intended rate identity. | No keys, private messages, CV text or receipt secrets are exposed through diagnostics.

title: Join release evidence, rollback and data restoration
decision: Make one current release/operations index authoritative; include every required migration in the manifest; retire or fix the auxiliary Pages deployment; rehearse code rollback and isolated synthetic private-data/file restoration.
dependencies: Existing v19/runtime57713fb receipt | Migration dependency inventory | Isolated encrypted backup/restore rehearsal | Additive schema compatibility
acceptance_criteria: Guest-support migration is included with its digest; omission fixtures fail release validation. | A failed build never uploads/deploys fallback public assets; canonical production target is explicit. | A release receipt joins frontend source/version, edge artifacts/versions and schema migration hashes. | Synthetic restore recovers ownership isolation, matching packet bytes and spending commitments; actual restore time/data-loss window are recorded. | Every active documented command exists; obsolete guides clearly redirect and blanket browser storage clearing is removed. | One capability matrix consistently states two-query/two-packet limits, current audiences and configured/optional/proposed features.

title: Show what actually ran, failed and needs attention
decision: Add safe correlation references, immutable processing-route receipts, distinct usable/partial/blocked outcomes and worker acknowledgement/progress. Correct settlement only for verifiably unbilled rejection; keep genuine uncertainty reserved.
dependencies: Allowlisted diagnostic/event contract | Provider response/error taxonomy | Worker acknowledgement and progress evidence | Existing shared atomic budget ledger
acceptance_criteria: A fictional candidate error links to an authorized worker event/run summary without private content in diagnostics. | Expected unavailable lane, provider fault, input hold and uncertain paid operation have distinct actions. | Worker500/timeout becomes actionable even while Cron dispatch attempts continue; paused/idle queues remain quiet. | Changing today's provider configuration cannot relabel yesterday's actual route; missing legacy metadata is explicitly unknown. | Only verified no-usage rejection releases its reservation; ambiguous calls remain held and never blindly replay. | Repeated identical faults group into one issue with count, owner, next action and recovery evidence.
finding_ids: BT-01; BT-02; BT-03; DEVOPS-02; API-01; BACKEND-01

title: Give every candidate a useful support reply and findable help
decision: Extend private Loop requests with versioned replies/dispositions, atomic idempotent intake and a shared founder view of guest/private queue age. Add task-language search aliases and account-access recovery help.
dependencies: Additive reply/version schema | Owner-only receipt read/write contract | Current help task inventory | Daily founder coverage
acceptance_criteria: A signed-in candidate reads a saved explanation and next step; another owner cannot access it. | Concurrent/retried intake creates one request under an atomic quota; stale reply writes are rejected and audited. | An older unresolved request remains findable as newer resolved cases arrive. | Resume upload, lost draft, password, evidence mismatch and cost hold lead to the appropriate task. | Support read/reply does not implicitly email anyone or send private text to a model.

title: Define and measure a useful first and second application
decision: Use one minimal event dictionary and consented ten-person research ledger. Separate guest/account flows, QA/cohort eligibility, actual candidate actions, scheduled preparation, opened usable artifacts and paired active effort.
dependencies: Research definitions set before results | Minimal event/privacy/retention design | Founder observation time | All three persona examples
acceptance_criteria: A metadata-only guest count can describe source→check→review→approved export action without CV text or sensitive URLs. | Prepared request, received inquiry, admitted account and genuine research participant remain separate denominators. | Scheduled runs cannot count as a voluntary human return; successful job-search exit is distinguished from harmful dropout. | First/repeat task records include active minutes, assistance, corrections, usefulness and non-completion reason. | Six usable first tasks/four voluntary repeats are only a provisional continue-learning trigger; broad expansion additionally requires eight usable completions, no systematic persona failure and cleared reliability gates. | Every report labels sample size, proxy semantics and missing evidence; ten participants do not establish population conversion or hiring success. | Server-owned cohort classification distinguishes participant, staff, demo, QA and unknown; costs and occupied seats retain all categories. | A usable packet from a partial run can reach its own approval/export task stage without claiming full source coverage. | Competitive exercises use identical fictional material or separately consented data and compare existing workflow plus two relevant alternatives; no superiority claim precedes observed results.

title: Know all-in pilot cost and fair access before pricing
decision: Maintain the hard shared ceiling, reconcile uncertain usage through a documented provider-evidence process, and show candidate/admin allocation, useful-artifact cost and separate infrastructure/operator expense. Keep future prices as experiments.
dependencies: JV-09 | JV-11 | Owner inventory of existing services/invoices | Shared cap and usage ledgers
acceptance_criteria: Committed equals settled actual plus reserved/uncertain liabilities across candidate and admin paths. | One account or admin batch cannot silently consume the pilot's intended allocation; the shared hard ceiling remains authoritative. | Cost per useful artifact states allocation/denominator and includes retries/failures; no fictitious exact packet-level cost is inferred from multi-packet runs. | Hosting, database, email/media/tools and founder support time are listed separately from the US$50 model/search cap. | Focus$15/Loop$29 remain uncharged hypotheses until actual cost, value and payment eligibility are established.

title: Use one clear offer and preserve audience context
decision: Align invitations, landing pages, help and historical assets around one CV plus one actual vacancy. Distinguish available self-serve software, assisted research and the ten-seat private pilot. Use MBA students/alumni job recruiting consistently.
dependencies: Canonical current capability matrix | Audience route/link tests | Owner-reviewed pilot brief
acceptance_criteria: A new reader can state inputs, deliverable, review responsibility and next action in their own words. | Student/MBA/professional links preserve intended audience into /check and link two relevant guides. | Explanatory saving links reach the public /job-loop overview; private work actions intentionally reach /loop. | Two role directions are not required to try the current first task; a second vacancy is a later optional reuse task. | Concept-demo/guided invitations and working-software invitations have explicit matching destinations.

title: Prepare a qualified, capacity-aware first-ten pilot
decision: Separate partner service relevance from participant readiness. Prepare a provisional3student/3MBA/4professional cohort, stage one participant per segment first, and verify actual cloud seats/support capacity before enrollment.
dependencies: JV-06 | JV-11 | JV-13 | Founder relationships and later authorized recruitment | Current active/QA enrollment and committed budget
acceptance_criteria: Each intended participant has an actual vacancy, existing CV/project evidence, available review time and a segment/source record. | Coach relevance, current service verification and willingness to introduce remain separate fields; unknowns stay unknown. | Request reception→acknowledgement→admission→agreed task is rehearsed with fictional data. | Ten participants are not promised ten additional cloud seats or an automaticUS$5entitlement. | A named owner/back-up checks both support queues and handles public exposed-data/inaccurate-claim concerns. | No invitations, followups, ads or messages are sent by this audit; founder research/support time is separately budgeted.

title: Build one evidence-led content and launch kit
decision: Upgrade four anchor guides around one reusable evidence worksheet with accurate per-guide dates. Prepare an original short fictional demo and persona variations, then test one distribution channel after pilot gates. Maintain a dated primary-source competitor watch.
dependencies: JV-11 | JV-13 | Verified product-screen capture and opened download | Founder editorial/video time | Current official competitor/platform sources
acceptance_criteria: Four guides cover CV-vacancy evidence, student projects, MBA pivots and second-application reuse using one concrete worksheet. | Guide updates change their own truthful dates/reviewer notes and relevant internal links. | A captioned35-second original demonstration uses enlarged readable passages, explicit fictional/AI labels and current /check CTA. | One master provides student, MBA and professional hooks without copying other creators or fabricated results. | LinkedIn and later Product Hunt/eligible Show HN are prepared as channel hypotheses; paidBetaList is excluded now. | A competitor update records observed URL/date/changed capability and whether it changes a product decision; no universal superiority or rank claims.

title: Defer optional email automation until it is requested and justified
decision: Keep drafts only now. Before future optional sending, implement purpose-specific choices, suppression/unsubscribe, idempotent task-based outbox and discreet actionable digests. Auth messages remain a separate operational stream.
dependencies: JV-06 | JV-11 | Validated need for email reminders | Existing sender/account decision and separate service costs
acceptance_criteria: Signup, pilot inquiry and preparation consent never silently subscribe anyone to optional mail. | Optout/complaint/bounce/erasure stop queued optional sends; unsubscribe works without login. | Completed/paused/closed tasks cancel reminders; timezone and duplicate-dispatch cases send at most one useful message. | No employer names, private CV text, receipt secrets or attachments are exposed in subject/tracking links. | Recommendation-only four-email draft sequence is tested with willing readers before any activation.

title: Harden optional Gmail reconnect before enabling it
decision: Keep optional Gmail off until its existing account/release gates are satisfied. Persist reconnect-required on revoked/expired credentials; distinguish transient failures and ambiguous draft creation.
dependencies: Existing Google OAuth verification/tester requirements | Explicit candidate inbox/draft consent | Idempotent write uncertainty handling
acceptance_criteria: Revocation/expiry cannot continue to claim an inbox check or connected working credentials. | Transient429/5xx preserves the connection and shows last successful check separately. | Ambiguous draft creation never blindly creates a duplicate; no employer message is sent automatically.

title: Tighten transaction ordering and measured query growth
decision: Use a consistent record/run lock order, fetch summary projections/cursors and apply measured indexes on actual query paths. Select recoverable leases before limiting the queue.
dependencies: Synthetic concurrency harness | Representative EXPLAIN evidence | Owner/date and lease-expiry query inventory
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent correction/commit stress tests preserve stale-input authority without lock-order deadlocks. | Run summaries exclude unused full snapshots and selected packets load on demand. | Live lease rows cannot starve recoverable older work through a pre-filter limit. | Index changes are justified by measured plans; advisor counts alone are not a reason to add or remove indexes.

title: Keep paid subscriptions behind a separate commercial release
decision: Keep checkout disabled. Later replace the old one-time ten-pack contract with one agreed recurring entitlement specification only when paid scope and account eligibility are established.
dependencies: Actual value and unit-cost evidence | Eligible merchant/provider account and paid-scope decision | Single price/allowance/refund specification
acceptance_criteria: Focus/Loop proposed prices and pack/run allowances match server-side recurring entitlements. | Renewal/reset, cancellation, failed payment, refund, duplicate event and reconciliation fixtures pass before real charges. | No legacy ten-pack route or fabricated paid entitlement silently substitutes for the subscription offer. | No payment account, gateway, recurring charge or paid conversion is activated by this audit.
